scenes.title: Here and there
scenes.goal: Find out what is here and what is over there
scenes.secret: The cat is here; the house is over there

scenes.title: At the table
scenes.goal: Ask what is on the table and ask for water or bread
scenes.secret: There is bread, soup, and water on the table

scenes.title: At breakfast
scenes.goal: Find out what there is to drink and order one thing
scenes.secret: There is tea and milk, but no coffee

scenes.title: Whose is it?
scenes.goal: Find out where the book and the letter are
scenes.secret: The book is on the table and the letter is in the bag

scenes.title: Speaking Russian
scenes.goal: Find out which languages your partner speaks
scenes.secret: Speaks Russian and a little English

scenes.title: In a shop
scenes.goal: Find out whether they have bread, and how much it costs
scenes.secret: The shop has bread (40 roubles) and milk, but no cheese today.

scenes.title: About a book you read
scenes.goal: Tell them what you are reading and find out what they read
scenes.secret: You read a book about space; you don't like poetry.

scenes.title: Who is at home?
scenes.goal: Find out who is at home right now and where the cat is
scenes.secret: Mom and dad are at home; the cat is in the kitchen.

scenes.title: My family
scenes.goal: Ask about your partner's brother or sister and what they love
scenes.secret: Has one sister who loves music and tea.

scenes.title: In the kitchen
scenes.goal: Find out what you have in the kitchen and what is missing
scenes.secret: There is bread and cheese, but no salt and no milk.

scenes.title: How many?
scenes.goal: Find out how many cups and chairs are in the room
scenes.secret: There are four chairs and three cups on the table.

scenes.title: In the city
scenes.goal: Find out where your partner is right now and what they see
scenes.secret: Sitting by a window in the city; sees a street and an old house.

scenes.title: Yesterday evening
scenes.goal: Find out where your partner was yesterday evening and what they did
scenes.secret: Was at home yesterday evening, reading a book and having dinner.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's plan
scenes.goal: Find out when your partner is free tomorrow and agree on a time
scenes.secret: Busy in the morning, free after lunch.

scenes.title: Going to the city
scenes.goal: Find out where your partner is going today and how they are getting there
scenes.secret: Going to work in the city by metro.

scenes.title: A message from space
scenes.goal: Find out what the station heard and which planet it came from
scenes.secret: Heard three numbers from a distant planet at night.

scenes.title: A number problem
scenes.goal: Find out which number your partner is thinking of
scenes.secret: The number is twelve: even, greater than ten, less than fifteen.

scenes.title: Why Russian?
scenes.goal: Find out why your partner is reading this book and tell them your reason
scenes.secret: Reading Tolstoy in the original because translations miss the voice.
